title: 第二十一章 不如小猫第二十二章 好的宿主
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
刚才她看那孩子瘦的都快要成杆了，肯定是饿极了才会来自己这里讨饭吃，不容易啊。
叶晚秋端着碗既然出门的时候，脚被地上的小猫扒拉住。
小猫喵喵两声，跑到不远处它的专属碗旁边，又喵喵两声。
叶晚秋看懂了它的意思，“你也饿了是吧？别急，我先把这一碗饭送出去，再来给你盛饭。”
她着急出门，没注意到小猫听了她的话之后屁股一扭，摆明了一副生气的样子。
叶晚秋快步走到门口，将那碗饭递给门口的弟子。
“给，你先吃，不够我厨房里还有。”
“够！谢谢婆婆！”
弟子接过碗的手都在颤抖，香味不停往鼻子里面钻，他是什么都顾不上了，端着碗在院门口一蹲，拿起筷子就开始往嘴里扒饭。
叶晚秋摇摇头，这孩子真可怜，都饿的低血糖了。
[滴！系统检测到最新插件。]
[最新插件安装中……安装成功！预计十秒钟后系统开始升级，本次升级预计三个小时。]
[系统升级中……]
叶晚秋一句话都没来得及开口，她脑子里的系统叭叭就是一阵，然后没有动静了。
就在她感叹这系统和之前家里的人工智能没有什么太大区别的时候，地上扒饭的弟子猛地站起来。
“婆婆，你做的饭也太好吃了！我从来没吃过这么好吃的饭！”
“好吃你就多吃……”
叶晚秋话还没说完，便看到他手里那已经空了的碗，吃完了？这么快？
看来孩子是真的饿急眼了。
她眼里再次流露出痛惜，拍拍面前小弟子的肩膀，“孩子你以后饿了就来婆婆这里，婆婆管你饭吃。”

“真的吗？”弟子的眼睛瞪大，连忙道谢：“谢谢婆婆！”
说着，从自己的储物袋里摸索一阵，掏出来一个小荷包。
“婆婆，这是我爹娘给的这个月的零花钱，都给你！谢谢你给我吃饭！”
这荷包连同那碗往叶晚秋碗里一塞，小弟子便跑开了。
叶晚秋：“……”
不就一碗饭吗？哪里还用给钱。
身后的房子里响起一阵噼里啪啦的动静，叶晚秋一惊，差点忘了厨房里还有个带着吃饭的‘小祖宗’呢。
她快步回去，进门的一瞬间又听到盘子掉落在地破碎的声音。
这些天给药尘子送饭，那些盘子都没能拿回来，房子里的盘子和碗所剩无几，又损失一个！
“小咪！你是不是又在……”
叶晚秋话都没说完，愣在原地。
这些天被她教训后变得温顺的小咪此刻弓着身体，咬住一只灰毛大耗子，紧接着一用力，那只还在挣扎的大耗子就没了动静。
小咪仰起脸，一甩脖子，将那耗子甩出窗户，然后十分优雅地舔爪子。
一整套操作把叶晚秋都看懵了，忍不住竖起大拇指。
“小咪，你太厉害了，居然还会抓老鼠！”
喵~
小猫仰起脸。
虽然叶晚秋听不懂猫的语言，但是她确定，这小猫此刻很骄傲。
在叶晚秋赞赏的目光中，小咪十分优雅地从桌子上跳下来，跑到它的碗旁边，喵喵两声。
“好好好，小咪要吃饭是吧？来了来了！”
content_en:
Just now she saw that the child was so thin that he was almost a man. He must be very hungry to come to her to beg for food. It was not easy.
When Ye Wanqiu went out with the bowl in hand, his feet were grabbed by the kitten on the ground.
The kitten meowed twice, ran to its exclusive bowl not far away, and meowed again.
Ye Wanqiu understood its meaning, "You're hungry too, right? Don't worry, I'll give this bowl of rice away first, and then I'll serve it to you."
She was in a hurry to go out and didn't notice that the kitten twisted its buttocks after listening to her words, showing an angry look.
Ye Wanqiu walked quickly to the door and handed the bowl of rice to the disciple at the door.
"Here, you eat first, I don't have enough left in the kitchen."
"That's enough! Thank you, mother-in-law!"
The hands of the disciple who took the bowl were trembling, and the fragrance kept entering his nose. He couldn't care about anything. He squatted at the entrance of the courtyard with the bowl, picked up the chopsticks and started to eat the rice in his mouth.
Ye Wanqiu shook his head. This child is so pitiful. He is so hungry that he has hypoglycemia.
[drop! The system has detected the latest plug-in. ]
[The latest plug-in is being installed...installed successfully! The system is expected to start upgrading in ten seconds, and this upgrade is expected to take three hours. ]
[System upgrade in progress...]
Ye Wanqiu didn't have time to say a word. The system in her mind buzzed for a while, and then there was no movement.
Just when she lamented that this system was not much different from the artificial intelligence at home before, the disciple who was eating rice on the ground suddenly stood up.
"Mother-in-law, the food you cook is so delicious! I have never had such delicious food!"
"If it tastes good, just eat more..."
Before Ye Wanqiu finished speaking, he saw the empty bowl in his hand. Have you finished eating? So fast?
It seems that the child is really hungry and anxious.
Her eyes showed regret again, and she patted the young disciple in front of her on the shoulder, "Son, when you are hungry, come to my mother-in-law, and she will take care of your food."
"Really?" The disciple's eyes widened and he quickly thanked: "Thank you, mother-in-law!"
As he spoke, he fumbled around in his storage bag and took out a small purse.
"Mother-in-law, this is this month's pocket money from my parents. It's all for you! Thank you for feeding me!"
The purse and the bowl were stuffed into Ye Wanqiu's bowl, and the young disciple ran away.
Ye Wanqiu: "..."
Isn’t it just a bowl of rice? No need to give money.
There was a burst of crackling movement in the house behind him. Ye Wanqiu was startled and almost forgot that there was a 'little ancestor' in the kitchen with food.
She hurried back, and the moment she entered the door she heard the sound of the plate falling to the ground and breaking.
These days, Wu Chenzi has been delivering meals, but he hasn't been able to get those plates back. There are very few plates and bowls left in the house, and another one has been lost!
"Xiaomi! Are you here again..."
Ye Wanqiu didn't even finish speaking, he was stunned on the spot.
Xiaomi, who had become docile after being taught a lesson by her these days, was now arching her body and biting a big gray-haired mouse. Then with a strong force, the still struggling big mouse stopped moving.
Xiaomi raised her face, flicked her neck, threw the mouse out of the window, and then licked her paws very gracefully.
Ye Wanqiu was stunned by the whole set of operations and couldn't help but give a thumbs up.
"Xiao Mi, you are so awesome, you can actually catch mice!"
Meow~
The kitten raised his face.
Although Ye Wanqiu couldn't understand the cat's language, she was sure that the kitten was very proud at the moment.
Under Ye Wanqiu's admiring gaze, Xiaomi jumped down from the table very gracefully, ran to its bowl, and meowed twice.
"Okay, okay, Xiaomi wants to eat, right? Come on, come on!"
